اقتحموا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمُوا (iqtaḥamū) /iq.ta.ħa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمُوا (uqtuḥimū) /uq.tu.ħi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اِقْتَحِمُوا (iqtaḥimū) /iq.ta.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
